question: Can the present rig leave founding food, encounter additional food, and cover its costs?
source_state: Existing dirty working tree retained; M4 adds observation and wave ablation before measuring baseline. Not the historical committed revision.

controllers.no_wave: same recurrent controller with wave disabled
controllers.wave_only: zero neural motor output plus authored wave; passive ligaments remain
controllers.rest: zero neural motor output and no wave; passive ligaments remain

environments.free: one founder, 2048 energy, no nutrient/reservoir/injection; no foraging requirement
environments.easy: one founder, 128 energy, 512 nutrient three sites from initial head, six axial placements over eight seeds, no inflow
environments.moderate: one founder, 512 energy, 512 nutrient six sites from head, same axial placements, no inflow
environments.sparse: one founder in existing 32-cubed nursery spacing 8, energy 128, stock 512, inflow/injection 64; reproduction capped at one to isolate founder

comparisons: Matched seed/environment/genome and initial body; differences in controller mode and condition budgets explicit. Compare v1 baseline then v2 correction with identical fixtures. No parameter optimization after results.
telemetry: Each organism each active tick: starting/ending energy, neural/actuator/maintenance/secretion/digging/birth/death accounts, intake, actual and reported joint increments, command/drive/effort/sensors/orientation, periodic COM travel, nearest extant food from head (observer only), exact automatic feeding attempt availability. Death before maintenance is retained.
distance_limits: Geometric periodic distance is a lower bound, not path reachability through bodies or fused flesh; near means <=2 sites, capture requires squared lattice distance <=2. Food-distance list sampled before tick, exact availability at uptake captured separately.
gates: Separately report mechanical translation, directional control, food encounter, consumption, costs/sustainability, survival, reproduction, learning. No retention/generalization experiment and no claim of learned improvement.
integrity: No changes to ecological energy, food spacing or actuator strengths. Explicit v2 corrects billed drive and false motion only after baseline. Historical v1 retained. Every trial failure preserved. Snapshots/configs and every-tick JSONL saved; traces may be gzip compressed losslessly.
external_research: None for this slice. Diagnosis uses source inspection and controlled interventions, not new biological claims. Existing references not re-consulted.
